appMcp.title: Orchester MCP server
appMcp.explanation: Automation controls projects, tasks, runs and approvals here, with the app’s own rules. Clients read the access token from orchester-mcp/{{pid}}.json in your application data folder (Local AppData on Windows, Application Support on macOS).
